answer: An identity is certified only by a perfect matching between the operator's karst tokens and distinct prism keys, and every matching needs its own fresh delta signed by a prism. The kth identity is accepted only after the operator funds a witness for each of the factorial of k matchings, so the tenth costs 3,628,800 witnesses while an honest newcomer costs one. Matchings cannot be split or reused because each witness must span the whole set, and a new karst set must carry the old set's cardinality.
